_dev_notes: DEV NOTE: Phase 1 v0 truth-surface manifest. This file defines the allowed Phase 1 input surface for v0 and should be treated as a drift-sensitive contract.
DEV NOTE: schema_version identifies this manifest shape. It must not be changed casually because CI and drift guards may rely on this exact contract identity.

DEV NOTE: top_level_allowed_fields is the closed list of accepted Phase 1 top-level fields. New product, organisation, analytics, advisory, or post-v0 fields must not be added here without an explicit release-boundary decision.

DEV NOTE: baseline_metric_allowed_fields is the closed list of accepted baseline metric fields. These fields record declared data only and must not imply assessment, scoring, readiness, suitability, or recommendations.
DEV NOTE: allowed_actor_types and allowed_execution_scopes keep v0 limited to individual_user, coach, individual, and coach_managed surfaces only.
DEV NOTE: allowed_activities keeps v0 limited to powerlifting, rugby_union, and general_strength. Adding sports here expands the truth surface and must be treated as scope change.
DEV NOTE: allowed_* arrays are exact enumerations. Do not replace them with inferred values, broad aliases, dynamic loading, or permissive matching.
DEV NOTE: Keep this file strict JSON. Do not add comments, trailing commas, JSONC syntax, or parser-specific extensions.
